title: SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2002, SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2002, SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the shooter category, SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
